name: v0.3.22 post-escape sink attractor analysis
research_question: Why does the same first Return-Waypoint Frontier Escape repair two of the four v0.3.20 positive targets and not the other two?

hypothesis_definitions.persistent_post_terminal_sink: Within the preregistered horizons, the remaining regression on the targets that lost template 5/8/9 at budget 120 is consistent with a post-terminal ordinary-policy attractor rather than sequence-scoped return-cycle failure or 120-step budget delay.
hypothesis_definitions.budget_delay: The budget-120 split was a finite-budget delay on the losing targets. The unchanged candidate reached the entity residual frontier and recovered template 5/8/9 by budget 240 or 480.
hypothesis_definitions.mixed_or_inconclusive: The preregistered budgets do not isolate one shared mechanism.
hypothesis_definitions.protocol_invalid: Freeze, protocol, semantic, or publication identity failed.

operational_definitions.navigation_edge: topology edge whose source and destination node ids differ, including parent-return edges
operational_definitions.relevant_abandonment: earliest sequence-scoped return_cycle_escape after the first waypoint escape whose branch_start is after that escape and whose sequence_terminal outcome is return_cycle_abandoned
operational_definitions.suffix: step rows with index strictly greater than the relevant abandonment step
operational_definitions.dominant_scc: SCC that contains a recurrent suffix page and has the greatest suffix visit coverage; equal coverage is ambiguous
operational_definitions.form_hub: empty-entity node with a parent_return edge to a non-empty-entity node and an incoming page-changing edge from an empty-entity node
operational_definitions.productive_reentry: after sink entry, the run reaches the first-escape entity cluster and executes a residual frontier action recorded on that escape
operational_definitions.sink_entry: first suffix step whose destination lies in the dominant SCC when coverage meets the threshold; otherwise the abandonment step
operational_definitions.ordinary_policy_recurrence: the abandoned sequence has no later events, and at least the dominance threshold of final-quartile dominant-SCC visits have an empty active branch
operational_definitions.horizon_cycle: latest post-escape sequence that has branch_start, sequence_horizon_reached, return_cycle_escape, and terminal return_cycle_abandoned
operational_definitions.template_589: manifest bug ids whose trailing integer is 5, 8, or 9
operational_definitions.guard_retained: v0.3.20 guard budget-120 confirmed set is a subset of the cell confirmed set
persistent_sink: sequence-scoped return_cycle_escape after the first waypoint escape

public_copy.persistent_post_terminal_sink: v0.3.22 没有改策略，只分析 v0.3.21 的分裂结果。Campus/Studio 在 sequence-scoped return cycle 已经被正确 abandon 后，普通探索仍进入重复 导航吸引子；到 b480 仍未重新获得原 entity residual frontier。Warehouse/Booking 则保留了回到 entity 的生产性路径。这是已检查目标上的 failure diagnosis，不是新修复，也不是 fresh validation。
public_copy.budget_delay: v0.3.22 没有改策略。提高诊断预算后，Campus/Studio 在冻结候选下重新进入 entity residual frontier 并恢复 5/8/9，因此 v0.3.21 的分裂更符合有限预算 延迟，而不是 b480 内持续的 post-terminal sink。
public_copy.mixed_or_inconclusive: v0.3.22 没有改策略。b240/b480 的分裂没有收敛到单一机制，诊断为 mixed_or_inconclusive。这不是新修复，也不是 fresh validation。
public_copy.protocol_invalid: v0.3.22 诊断协议未能成立，结论为 protocol_invalid。没有改策略，也没有新修复。
